packageRules.description: The AndroidX Remote Compose player is an alpha line separate from the Compose BOM, and it is what the apps play `.rc` documents and UI-builder designs with. The preset's androidx-compose group would bump it with the BOM; keep it in its own PR, never automerged: a player bump changes what every previewed document looks like, and the restricted player APIs `:player` calls move between alphas. Take a version at or ahead of what the UI builder exports.
